justifications.technical_correctness: Gravity, grounded jump, axis movement and one-shot pickup with deferred monitoring are correct.
justifications.api_correctness: get_gravity, get_axis, move_and_slide, signal emit, and set_deferred are used correctly.
justifications.version_compatibility: Uses Godot 4 idioms: typed signal emit, Callable connect, argument-less move_and_slide.
justifications.architectural_quality: Coin owns its own collection logic, uses a signal and a group check; decoupled.
justifications.requirement_fulfillment: Movement, jump, gravity, and coin collected exactly once all implemented.
justifications.source_quality: Reasoning explained but no documentation or sources cited.
justifications.provenance: Claims not traceable to any referenced docs or evidence.
justifications.hallucinations: get_gravity described as project default only; it also includes area overrides.
justifications.clarity: Clear, organized per-file explanation that you can act on.
